    Bug 2009930 - Fix handling command context change for MailTabButtons in message tab. r=freaktechnik
    
    
    In order to handle the command context when another message is selected in a
    message tab, have any MailTabButton observe the "MsgLoaded" event as well.
    
    This fixes the behavior for the MailGoButton and the DeleteButton, and a
    special ReplyListButton is no longer needed.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D279217
